plan.title: UI-VBID-012 — Reject text in price cell

steps.note: Start a multi-stage-capable event create flow for the RFQ bid test.
Create an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product so the vendor has a price cell to edit.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to submit a bid.
Publish the RFQ so its vendor price sheet is available.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor’s supplier portal.
Open the event’s vendor pricing sheet.
Assert that entering non-numeric text in the vendor price cell is refused or produces positive refusal evidence, rather than being accepted as zero.
Return to the buyer console to verify the refusal did not create a response.
Open the RFQ Responses view for the buyer-side oracle.
Confirm no vendor response or bid, including a bid at price zero, was created.
